violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed employee dip hands into sanitizer solution in the 3 vat sink and then proceed to handle dishes in the mechanical warewashing machine
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. Person in charge stopped employee and had them wash their hands following proper handwashing procedure. GARDENS AT FAIR OAKS (Inspection Date: 10/08/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed basement kitchen sink did not have paper towels provided
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Person in charge had maintenance replace the paper towels

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Employee used restroom did not have a proper handwashing sign
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. Person in charge agreed to replace the handwashing sign in the employee used restroom.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: Observed mechanical warewashing using bleach based sanitizer. Sanitizer level was observed at not correct concentration to sanitize dish surfaces. Observed bleach @ 10 ppm, required by dish machine 50 ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dischmachine so that food contact surfaces are exposed to sanitizer for the required amount of time per the data plate. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food contact surfaces. Person in charge discontinued use of mechanical warewashing machine for sanitizing procedure, will continue use to wash dishes, will use 3 vat sink for sanitizing procedure until repair technician can be contacted to have machine repaired

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food on the floor of the walk in cooler and the walk in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Person in charge had food moved to shelving racks of the walk in cooler and freezer

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. Person in charge moved wet wiping clothes to sanitizer solution containers

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): observed being used as food storage container in the kitchen area
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. Person in charge agreed to remove the milk crate and to discontinue use of milk crates as food storage

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: Tin foil was being used as a liner on the grill
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Person in charge agreed to remove the tinfoil

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed in the 2nd floor service kitchen, no back flow prevention device has been provided for the in use ice machine
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. Person in charge agreed to contact a plumber to install a backflow prevention device for the 2nd floor service kitchen, will contact EHS when installed.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food directly stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO GET THE FOOD ITEMS OFF THE FLOOR AND ONTO PROPER SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS. PLEASE DO NOT USE MILK CRATES OR SODA CRATES. GARDENS AT FAIR OAKS (Inspection Date: 03/12/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) ICE CREAM SCOOPS STORED IN WATER IN THE MAIN KITCHEN AREA.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO KEEP THE ICE CREAM SCOOPS DRY UNLESS THE WATER IS CONSTANTLY RUNNING OR MAINTAINED AT 135F OR ABOVE AT ALL TIMES.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): 1) ELEVATE ITEMS OFF THE FLOOR IN THE WALK-IN FREEZER AND DRY STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO REMOVE ALL REUSED MILK CRATES AND STORE FOODS ON PROPER SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved type of splitter used on both mop sinks. The system is under constant pressure.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS SHOWED A PICTURE TO THE MANAGER OF AN APPROVED PRESSURE BLEED DEVICE. MANAGER WILL ORDER THE PRESSURE BLEED DUAL VALVE TODAY FOR BOTH MOP SINKS. PLEASE SEND ME A PICTURE OF BOTH MOP SINKS WHEN THE DEVICES HAVE BEEN INSTALLED.
